name: nexashare
description: Secure, local-first file sharing between Windows and Android

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @nexashare/protocol && npm run build -w @nexashare/shared && npm run build -w @nexashare/validation && npm run build -w @nexashare/transfer-core
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:packages && npm run start -w @nexashare/desktop
